name_reason: Already convention-compliant: data_fd2_ prefix; 'shared' reflects it is the single global RNG state consumed across combat/heal/spell-cast/animation/cutscene (sole accessor fd2_advance_rng_state has 23 call sites); 'rng_seed' descriptor names the data role (scalar PRNG state). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Datatype role (scalar state) is conveyed by 'seed'.
purpose: Shared 16-bit pseudorandom number generator state for the whole game.
logic_summary: Read-modify-write in place by its sole accessor fd2_advance_rng_state @ 0x4E893: seed = ROL16(seed + 0x9014, 3) (disasm: XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AX,[0x627B8]; ADD AX,0x9014; ROL AX,1 x3; MOV [0x627B8],AX). Zero-initialized; starts at 0 so the first advance yields ROL16(0x9014,3) = 0x80A4. No other code reads or writes this address (xrefs: READ @0x4E895, WRITE @0x4E8A8 only).
element_semantics: Single scalar: current 16-bit PRNG seed/state, advanced by the LFSR-style scramble. Not an array.
notes: Ghidra data plate at 0x627B8 was blank (PLATE=[null]); created a concise plate consistent with the src comment (which is the source of truth and already accurate/precise). battle.c was NOT edited (comment_verdict=keep), so the only staged file is this shard. Datatype confirmed undefined2/LEN=2 with value 0x0000 via listing. Note: same ROL16(state+0x9014,3) scramble step is shared with fd2_save_crypt_buffer @ 0x4DBD8 per the accessor's plate.
